text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
The "URA Finals"... This stage looks set 
to bring forth brand-new drama.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, now that you've sent off your 
trainee, how are you feeling right now?

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Even surrounded by the formidable 
qualifiers who fought their way up, an 
unshakeable confidence in victory shines 
through!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Ah... To lavish me with praise and 
appreciation in victory, and even prepare 
a celebration party at a luxury hotel...

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: I'm rooting for you as well, <chrname>!

The "URA Finals"— The semifinals are 
finally about to begin!
